mechanism.summary: Remove per-operation allocation and frame construction from string equality and typeof: compare stored strings by bytes and stream UTF-16 code units only for two distinct non-ASCII strings (string_utf16_eq and relational comparison materialized two Vec<u16> per compare), share the eight typeof result strings, let the wide compact tier evaluate strict equality and primitive loose equality without building a throwaway CallEnv, and admit wide-tier bodies whose only unsupported operation was a handler-free throw. Plan written after one exploratory screen of the implementation; the target is the queue's rank-1 opportunity named by the profile, not a case picked from screen results.
mechanism.generality: Every `typeof x == 'name'` test, string switch case, and string equality or ordering in any tier pays the removed allocations; every wide-tier binary operation on strings paid the removed frame. Bodies with throw-on-invalid-input branches are common library style. Nothing depends on a workload name, iteration count, or key set.
semantic_risks: Lone surrogates stored as escape characters must still compare equal to the same code units stored as a whole surrogate pair
String ordering must stay by UTF-16 code unit, not code point
Loose equality with an object operand must still run ToPrimitive and user valueOf/toString
A throw inside an admitted body must reach the interpreter's handler with the identical value and uncaught message

profile_evidence.shared_cost: Exact queue-candidate binary, one-second macOS sample of the official hash-map bundle. malloc/free top-of-stack frames total about 70 samples, Value drop 50, general-path Vm construction 22 and CallEnv drop 12 of roughly 1000. A same-binary microbenchmark isolating computeHashCode/equals attributed a third of its samples to malloc/free, called from string_code_units under string_utf16_eq and from typeof_value, and 57 samples to CallEnv construction inside WideActivation::eval_binary. QJS_CF_TRACE named computeHashCode (declined for its throw) behind all 540k general-path frames.
